summary: iter-294 Adin CloseFit backend regression — 21/21 tests PASS (100%). Verified: (1) UNP CloseFit returns EXACTLY 6 lengths [10, 11.5, 13, 15, 16, 18] with 8mm removed; NP=6, RP=6, WP=12 SKUs across Ø4.3+Ø5.0. (2) Primary drilling protocols are now SEQUENTIAL (Pilot 2.0 + Twist 2.8 + Twist 3.2 + …) per all 4 CloseFit platforms. (3) alt_protocol='Tri-Step Drill (alternative)' present ONLY on RP/WP CloseFit — UNP/NP CloseFit correctly return alt_protocol=null. Step counts validated: RP Ø3.5 L11.5 D2 = 4 steps (3 drills + placement) / alt 2 steps; WP Ø5.0 L13 D2 = 7 steps / alt 4 steps; WP Ø4.3 L11.5 D2 = 5 steps / alt 2 steps; UNP Ø2.75 L10 D2 = 3 steps / no alt; NP Ø3.0 L11.5 D2 = 3 steps / no alt. (4) Cortical-only logic preserved: RP Ø3.5 D2 step 3 (Twist 3.2) → cortical_only=True, depth='Cortex only'; D1 step 3 → cortical_only=False, numeric depth. (5) D4 soft-bone behaviour: RP=2 steps, NP=2 steps, UNP=3 steps. (6) Step schema validated — all DRILL steps carry {step, drill_type, code, diameter, depth, cortical_only, rpm, irrigation, note}. (7) Components expanded per platform: UNP=30, NP=30, RP=30, WP=49; is_stub=false; updated_by='adin_components_expanded:iter-294'. (8) WP screw_retained_abutment breakdown verified: 15 total = TMA straight 5 + TMA 17° 4 + TMA 30° 4 + flat-connection 2. (9) Cement abutment angulations {0°, 15°, 25°} present in catalog. (10) Regression PASSED: Touareg-OS/S, Swell, One libraries+drilling unchanged; Straumann BLT (3 systems) + BLX (4 systems) library intact; BLX components still return 135 RB / 68 WB.
